caption: The drawing consists of six distinct panels arranged in two rows of three, each separated by decorative, multicolored borders featuring blue, green, and red geometric and floral patterns. In the top left panel, a figure in a blue robe with red accents and gold spots stands holding a sword in their right hand and a pair of scales in their left hand, with a small green plant at their feet on a red ground. The top middle panel contains three figures: a central crowned figure in a robe flanked by two smaller people with bare torsos, one with hands clasped in prayer, below a lamb, all enclosed within an ornate oval frame. The top right panel mirrors the left, with a blue-robed figure, also with red accents and gold spots, holding a staff topped with a cross in the right hand and an object resembling a branch or bunch of flowers in the left hand, with a plant at their feet. In the bottom left panel, a figure in a long red robe with a blue veil stands within an oval frame, with rays extending from their head and a small green plant at their feet. The bottom center panel features a figure in green and white robes holding a staff, framed by an archway. The bottom right panel displays a figure in blue and red garments with rays extending from their head, standing within an oval frame that is lined with yellow rays, above a smaller figure with arms raised inside a semicircular basin or container, flanked by plants. The overall color palette includes red, blue, green, yellow, white, and gray, with a predominance of these colors in the clothing, frames, and decorative elements.
title: Plate 6: Chapel Altarpiece, Santa Cruz: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
